people.name: Sitnah
people.line: Well dug by Isaac, disputed by Philistines

translations.web: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. He called its name Sitnah.
translations.bsb: Then they dug another well and quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.
translations.kjv: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
translations.asv: And they digged another well, and they strove for that also. And he called the name of it Sitnah.
